name: Overdue Installations
query:
SELECT
    ro.name as 'Order ID',
    ro.customer as 'Customer',
    ro.expected_installation_date as 'Expected Date',
    DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), ro.expected_installation_date) as 'Days Overdue',
    ro.status as 'Status',
    ro.grand_total as 'Grand Total'
FROM `tabReno Order` ro
WHERE ro.expected_installation_date < CURDATE()
    AND ro.status NOT IN ('Installed', 'Closed', 'Cancelled')
ORDER BY ro.expected_installation_date ASC
